literal_meaning: পথ তৈরি করা (to make a path)
figurative_meaning_en: To find a way or devise a solution
example_sentences_in_bangla: সমস্যা থেকে পথ করে নেওয়া গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He found a way out of the problem.
She devised a solution in the difficult situation.
note: This idiom metaphorically refers to creating an escape or solution, rooted in the imagery of clearing a path in rural or travel contexts.
